assertions.assertion: The member was evaluated and diagnosed with symptoms coded R00.2 (absence of pulse)
The member was diagnosed with symptoms coded R42 (syncope)
The member presented with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment
The mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was documented in the clinical indication note
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The member retains the right to appeal this determination
